translations.<b>Kega Refusion</b><br>Компактный эмуля:
Kega Refusion
A compact emulator based on Genesis Plus GX (Libretro).

Games: MD, GEN, BIN, SMD, 32X, SMS, GG, SG, 68K.
Sega CD: CUE, ISO, CHD, M3U.
MegaLD: MMI.
ZIP and 7z archives are supported.

translations.Для обычных игр Mega Drive: «Автоматичес: For standard Mega Drive games, “Automatic” selects hardware based on the game, “Connected” always connects it, and “Disconnected” disconnects it. Sega CD and 32X games connect the required hardware regardless of this setting. Sega CD requires a regional BIOS; 32X uses built-in BIOS when originals are not installed. Changes take effect when the next game loads or after a power cycle.
translations.BIOS Sega CD и дополнительные оригинальн: Sega CD BIOS and optional original 32X BIOS files.
translations.32X использует оригинальный BIOS для каж: 32X uses an original BIOS for each installed component (68000, Master SH2, Slave SH2), with a built-in fallback for each missing component. CD32X also requires a Sega CD BIOS for the matching region.
